statusLine.command: read -r payload; m=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Unknown"'); c=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // 0'); b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'no-git'); printf '\033[36m🤖 %s\033[0m  \033[33m📊 %s%%\033[0m  \033[32m🌿 %s\033[0m' "$m" "$c" "$b"
